title: Tech Note: Stemming Algorithm for Query Expansion
author: Timothy Tse, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: The Porter 2 stemming algorithm is language theory, not 4D-version-specific technology, so this Tech Note remains technically accurate and directly usable in current 4D versions with only minor syntax modernization (e.g., typed variables vs. C_TEXT declarations). It predates ORDA-based full-text search features, and if this were rewritten today it would likely use collection/ORDA idioms, but the algorithm and component design are unaffected by the 4D Design Mode-to-Project Mode transition.
related_updates: Modern 4D collection and Regex-based text commands available since v16+
ORDA/entity selection based querying that could combine with stemmed search terms
